content: Halaqati Immida Imota
Musey Gaytoteththa Dunkaaneza toli giigida wode Dunkaanezanne izan go7ettiza miishshata ubbaa, yarsho yarshizasozanne izan go7ettiza miishshata tiydi dummasides.
Hessafe guye Isra7eele asaa kaaleththizayti, deraa qoodiza wode istta bolla alaafeteththi diza korapinneti wuri ba yarsho yarsho GODAAS shiishshida.

Istti shiishshida yarshoti nam7u nam7u halaqata sunththan issi para-gaare, hessaththoka issi issi halaqa sunththan issi issi boora; he istti shiishshida yarshoti issi bolla usuppun para-gaaretanne tamman nam7u boorata; heyta he yarshotakka Gaytoteththa Dunkaaneza sinththan shiishshida.
GODAY Muses hizgides,
«Hayti miishshati Gaytoteththa Dunkaanezan dumma dumma oosos isttan go7ettana mala hayta yarsho miishshata isttafe ekkada, dumma dumma oosos isttas koshshiza mala shaakkada Lewetas imma.»
Hessa gishshas Musey para-gaaretanne boorata ekkidi Lewetas immides.
Gershoone zarkketas oosos koshshiza nam7u para-gaaretanne oyddu boorata immides.
Qasseka Meraare zarkketas oyddu para-gaaretanne osppun boorata immides; heytantta oosoy polettanay Aaroone naa Itamaare alaafeteththanna.
Isttas diza alaafeteththi geeshsha miishshata ba hashen tookkiza gishshas Musey Qa7aate zarkketas para-gaareta gidiin woykko booratakka immibeenna.
Yarsho yarshizasoza Musey tiydi geeshshida gallas halaqati yarsho yarshizasoza anjjisanaas bantta imota ehidi yarsho yarshizasoza sinththan shiishshida.
GODAY Muses, «Tammanne nam7u gallassatan tammanne nam7u halaqati pacey baynda issoy issoy issi issi gallas anjjiso ba7aales gidiza yarsho hu7en hu7en shiishshana mala yoota» gides.
Koyro gallas Yuhuda qommota garsafe Aminadaabe naa Ne7asooney shiishshides.
Izi shiishshida yarshotikka hayssafe kaallizayta; erettida meezaanen woththiin 130 saqile
birappe oosettida issi picca saanenne 70 saqile
issi guuqa saane, nam7ayka kath yarsho shiishshanaas liiqo dhiillefe zayten munuqettida munuqan kumida.
Izan exaaney kumi uttida 10 saqile
worqqafe oosettida cilfa.
Xuugettiza yarshos issi mirgo, issi dharsho, issi layththa dharsho laaqqa,
Nagara yarshos issi deysha orge,
issifeteththa yarshos 2 boorata, 5 dharshota, 5 deysha orgetanne layth kumida 5 dharsho laaqqata; heyti wuri Aminadaabe naa Ne7asooney shiishshida yarshota.
Nam7anththo gallas Yisakoore zarkketa garsafe Xu7aare naa Natina7eeley shiishshides.

Izan exaaney kumi uttida tammu saqile worqqafe oosettida cilfa.

Yarsho yarshizasoza tiydi geeshshida gallas halaqati yarshosoza anjjiso gaason shiishshida imotay haytantta; birappe oosettida 12 picca saaneta, birappe oosettida 12 guuqa saanetanne worqqafe oosettida isttan exaane woththiza 12 kereta.

Birappe oosettida issi issi kerey 130 saqile gidi deexxees; birappe oosettida issi issi quule mala saaney 7 saqile gidi deexxees; birappe oosettida keretinne quule mala saaneti Xoossa Keeththa meezaanen woththiza wode ubbay issi bolla 2,400 saqile
gidida.
Worqqafe oosettida exaaney istta kumi uttida tammanne nam7u shaatetti GODAA Keeththa meezaanen woththiza wode issoy issoy 10 saqile gidishin ubbay issi bolla 120 saqile
gidides.
Kaththa yarshora issife xuugettiza yarshos shiiqida mehe qooday 12 boorata, 12 dharshotanne layth kumida 12 dharsho laaqqata; qasse istti nagara yarshos shiishshiday 12 deysha orgeta.

Issifeteththa yarshos shiiqida mehe qooday 24 boora, 60 dharsho, 60 deysha orgenne layth kumida 60 dharsho laaqqa; yarsho yarshizasozi tiyetti geeyidaappe guye anjjiso ba7aales imettida imotati haytantta.

Musey GODAARA haasayanaas gede Gaytoteththa Dunkaanezan geliin atoteth demmanaas shiiqizason Taabotaa kama bolla diza nam7u Kirubeta giddora GODAY izas haasayza qaala siyidi izikka izara haasayettides.
